summary: Arcosa, Inc. disclosed entry into a definitive merger agreement with CRH Americas, Inc., under which Neon Merger Sub will merge into Arcosa, with Arcosa surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent. Shareholders will receive $150.00 per share in cash, representing a premium to the pre-announcement price. The deal is subject to customary closing conditions including adoption by a majority of Arcosa's shareholders and regulatory approvals. The board has not yet disclosed its recommendation or named advisors. Post-closing, Arcosa common stock will no longer be publicly traded. Watch for shareholder vote timing and regulatory review.
